SHOTS.txt: This is the one I make when I feel like I haven't had a vegetable in three days. Which,

Forty-six years of marriage, and he would not eat it.
Unless there was cheese on it.

Here's what you need.
One cup of broccoli florets, fresh or frozen.

Half a cup of milk.
Half a cup of shredded sharp cheddar. A pinch of salt

Drain it.

big bag of florets, not the little boxes.

Off the heat, and stir, and it melts down

Half a cup of cottage cheese, cold, right on the hot
potato, with a lot of black pepper and a few chives.
That was the diet plate at every diner in the fifties. It's cool and creamy, and it's abou
The fourth one is a can of chili, when you didn't make any. Heat half
a can, and put the other half in a jar in the refrigerator.
The store brand works fine.
Add a spoon of chopped onion and some cheese, and it's not my church chili, but it's suppe
And the fifth one is egg salad. Two hard-cooked
eggs, chopped, a tablespoon of
mayonnaise, a little mustard, salt and pepper.
Spoon it into a potato that's just warm, not hot.
It's a summer supper, when it's too hot to turn on
the oven, and you used the potato you baked on Sunday.
And one more thing about sweet potatoes, since a few of you have asked.
Every one of these works on a baked sweet potato, too,
especially the chili and the black bean taco.
Bake it at four hundred degrees for forty-five to fifty
minutes, on a piece of foil, because a
sweet potato drips sugar and it'll burn on your oven floor.
A sweet potato is about the same price, and it's very good for you.
§CH11C§ Now, I told you that on Friday, whatever potato is left
goes into a pot of soup. So let me show you,
because this is how I never throw away a baked potato.
The potato soup in my book is the big Sunday version, from raw potatoes, with bacon.
This is the little Friday version, from one potato you
already baked. It makes one big bowl.
Here's what you need.
One leftover baked potato.
One tablespoon of butter. One tablespoon of flour.
One cup of milk. Half a cup of chicken broth.
A quarter cup of shredded cheddar. One green onion. Salt and pepper.
And a strip of bacon, if you have one.
Once more. One baked potato. One tablespoon butter. One tablespoon flour. One cup milk. Ha
If you have the bacon, cook it first in your little
saucepan till it's crisp, and lay it on a paper
towel. Pour off all but a spoon of the fat.
Cut the potato in half and scoop the
inside out with a spoon. Keep the skin.
Chop the skin up small, because that's where the flavor is.
Melt the butter in the saucepan over medium heat, and
stir in the flour. Let it cook one minute.
Then whisk in the milk, a little at a time, and then the
broth. Keep stirring, and let it bubble,
about three minutes, till it's a little thick.
Now add the potato and the chopped skin, and mash it right in the pot with a potato masher
Leave some lumps. Lumps are good, honey.
Let it simmer three more minutes, and stir it so the bottom
doesn't scorch. Milk scorches fast in a thin
pan, so keep the heat at medium, not high.
Taste it, and add salt and pepper.
Pour it in a bowl, and put the cheese on top, and the bacon crumbled, and the green onion
That's loaded baked potato soup for about a dollar ten. And it took fifteen minutes, becau
And while we're talking about leftovers, here's how I keep a baked potato. Let it cool, an
Never in the foil. It keeps four days.
To warm it up, cut it open, put a spoon of water
on it, and microwave it two minutes, or put it
in a four hundred degree oven for fifteen minutes.
And plain baked potatoes don't freeze well, they go watery.
That's why the twice-baked is the one I freeze.
§CH12§ Now let me show you how all of this fits in one week, because that's how I really d

Sunday night, the chili potato.

bake.title: Loretta's Baked Potatoes
steps: Scrub and dry potatoes well
Poke each potato 6-8 times with fork
Rub with oil and sprinkle with salt
Bake at 425°F on oven rack, 55-60 min
Refrigerate within 2 hours, keep 4 days
bake.tip: Never wrap in foil—crisp skin holds your supper

chili.title: Chili Cheese Potato
steps: Brown beef and onion in skillet
Add chili powder, cumin, cook 30 sec
Add tomato sauce, beans, salt, sugar
Simmer 10 min, stir till thick
Split potato, fluff, butter, top with chili, cheese, onions
chili.tip: Fluff the potato and add butter before toppings

broc.title: Broccoli and Cheese Potato
steps: Steam broccoli 2 min, drain
Melt butter, stir in flour 1 min
Whisk in milk, cook till thick
Off heat, stir in cheese, salt, pepper
Split potato, fluff, pile broccoli, pour cheese sauce
broc.tip: Add cheese off the heat for smooth sauce

ham.title: Ham and Cheese Potato
steps: Brown ham in skillet with half the butter
Scoop potato, mash with butter, sour cream, cheese
Stir in most ham, refill skins
Top with rest of ham, cheese
Bake at 400°F, 12 min, sprinkle chives
ham.tip: Brown the ham for best flavor

taco.title: Taco Potato
steps: Brown meat, drain grease
Add taco seasoning, water, cook 2 min
Split potato, fluff, spoon in meat
Top with cheese, then lettuce, salsa, sour cream
Add tomato if you like
taco.tip: Put cold toppings on hot meat for best taste

bbq.title: BBQ Chicken Potato
ingredients: 1/4 cup shredded cheddar or Monterey Jack
steps: Mix chicken with barbecue sauce, microwave 1 min
Split potato, fluff, butter, salt
Pile in chicken, top with cheese
Broil 1 min till cheese bubbles
Top with red and green onion
bbq.tip: Broil just a minute—cheese burns fast

gravy.title: Sausage Gravy Potato
steps: Brown sausage in skillet, no pink
Sprinkle flour, cook 1 min
Stir in milk, bubble till thick, 3 min
Add pepper, salt
Split potato, mash, pour gravy over
gravy.tip: Don’t drain sausage—fat makes the gravy

twice.title: Twice-Baked Potato
twice.serves: Two halves (one supper, one for freezer)
steps: Cook bacon, crumble
Halve potato, scoop insides to bowl
Mash with butter, sour cream, milk, cheese
Stir in bacon, onion, salt, pepper, refill skins
Bake at 400°F, 20 min till golden
twice.tip: Taste the filling before baking—it should taste good

soup.title: Friday Leftover Potato Soup
steps: Cook bacon, set aside, save fat
Scoop potato, chop skin
Melt butter, stir in flour 1 min
Whisk in milk, broth, simmer 3 min
Add potato, mash, simmer 3 min, top with cheese, bacon, onion
soup.tip: Chop and use the potato skin—it adds flavor
